name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

eligibility.income_limit: Based on SECC 2011 data. Focuses on bottom 40% of the population.
eligibility.age_limit: No specific age limit (senior citizens 70+ now fully covered unconditionally)
eligibility.other_conditions: Must be listed in the SECC 2011 database or possess a valid ration card.

benefits: Health insurance cover of up to Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
application_process: Verify eligibility online via 'Am I Eligible' portal.
Visit a PMJAY empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre.
Complete KYC using Aadhaar to generate Ayushman Card.
